# Keep-as-is list used by 2_extract_texts.py to pre-filter <a:t> runs that are
# intentionally English (or non-translatable) and should NOT be sent to the LLM
# for translation.
#
# Format:
#   - Lines starting with '#' or blank are ignored.
#   - Lines starting with 're:' are compiled as Python regular expressions and
#     matched with re.fullmatch against the normalized run text.
#   - Other lines are compared (after normalize_text) for exact equality with
#     the full normalized <a:t> run text.
#
# Notes:
#   - Only *full-run* matches are skipped. Product names that appear inside a
#     larger sentence are still extracted (and should be translated).
#   - This file mirrors the contents of residual_allowlist.txt by convention.
#     They are kept separate so 2_extract_texts.py and 3_apply_translations.py
#     can be deployed independently. They may be unified in a future refactor.

# Regex patterns
re:https?://\S+
re:aka\.ms/\S+
re:Microsoft\.[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9.]*
re:©\s*Copyright\s+Microsoft\s+Corporation\.?\s+All\s+rights\s+reserved\.?
re:[Vv]?\d+(?:\.\d+){1,3}
re:Windows\s+Server\s+\d{4}
re:\.NET(?:\s+(?:Core|Framework|\d+(?:\.\d+)?))?
re:\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*(?:%|TB|GB|MB|KB|GiB|MiB|KiB|ms|s|min|h|hrs?|days?|cores?|vCPUs?|Mbps|Gbps|Kbps|RU/s)
re:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})*(?:\.\d+)?
re:[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+
